answer: One inlet, one tide-mill: the ferrous wheel mills one sack per funding trail per tide, extra sacks queue with the fee doubling per sack in line. Each sack needs a fresh pigment stamp mixed from three strangers' pots, each pot single-use per epoch, so n clones need 3n pots from a finite pool whose price rises with demand. At a random minute the beacon sweeps a magnet over the sacks: sacks sharing one iron filing source stick together and are seized as one. A fleet pays 3n pots at rising prices plus doubling queue fees for one payout; one honest agent pays once and mills alone.
